verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਚਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੇਖ ਸਿਵਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bedh bira(n)ch bichaar na paavat chakirat sekh sivaadh bhe hai ||

en.bdb: Swaiya - Brahma studied and reflected on the Vedas yet could not fathom the beginning and the end of the infinite Lord. Sheshnag, with his thousand tongues and Shiv Ji are falling into ecstatic state singing His paeans and contemplating on His extent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਰਾਧਤ ਨਾਰਦ ਸਾਰਦ ਸੁਕ੍ਰ ਸਨਾਤ ਨਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jog samaadh araadhat naaradh saaradh sukr sanaat ne hai ||

en.bdb: Sage Narad, goddess Saraswati, Shukracharya and Sanatan the sons of Brahma are bowing before Him after contemplating on Him in meditation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਾਪ ਜਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aadh anaadh agaadh agochar naam nira(n)jan jaap je hai ||

en.bdb: The Lord who is since the beginning of the beginning, is beyond the beginning is spread beyond the comprehension of mind and senses. Such mammonless and blemishless Lord is being meditated upon by all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਮੇਵ ਸੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ॥ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਏ ਭਾਈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਏ ਹੈ ॥੫੫੬॥
verses.translit_en: sree gurdhev sumev su sa(n)gat || pairee pe bhaiee pairee pe hai ||556||

en.bdb: The True Guru who is engrossed in such God is absorbed and permeated in the congregation of supreme people. 0 brother! I fall, yes I fall on the holy feet of such a True Guru.  (554)
